newsitem.title: UK: ICN buys stake in Hungary's Alkaloida.
newsitem.headline: ICN buys stake in Hungary's Alkaloida.

text.p: ICN Pharmaceuticals Inc reached definite agreement to buy a majority stake in Hungarian pharmaceutical firm Alkaloida Chemical Company Ltd, the U.S. firm said in a statement released here.
ICN said its initial holding will be 50.02 percent. The stake will increase to over 60 percent in the next several months. The Hungarian government will retain a 25 percent stake in Alkaloida.

"The acquisition of Alkaloida is part of our Eastern European expansion strategy and is a significant addition to our pharmaceutical network in this region," said Milan Panic, chairman, president and chief exective of ICN in a statement.
ICN won the right to acquire a majority interest in June through a competitive bidding process.
Alkaloida has annual sales of about $66 million.
